snippet.title: Playing Rampallians
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4363230/Rampallians/

Rampallians is a blend of resource gathering strategy games, PvP card games, and autobattlers. Build your settlement, defend it, and defeat your opponent. With nearly 400 cards between 4 factions, play your way. With no pay to win, ever.
